epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce the rate of bypassed CI checks and fake approvals from >0% to 0%
requirements: R1: Dockerfiles must not bypass the test suite during the build process
R2: Automated PR review approvals must be structurally validated to contain substantive critique

slices.title: Enforce test execution and validate review payloads
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pipeline fixes for this epic, I want to remove test-skipping arguments and add review payload validation, so that the review gate cannot be bypassed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Dockerfile in the build context,
When the container image is built,
Then Maven executes the full test suite without the -DskipTests flag.
Given an automated review submission,
When the system evaluates the review payload,
Then it rejects the approval if it lacks genuine reasoning.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce the count of -DskipTests instances in Dockerfiles to 0 and increase review validation coverage to 100%
